author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI Art & Image Generator](https://ai-image-generator-w-m5n8.bolt.host) to image
- AI Art & Image Generator utilizes the powerful Pollinations.ai API to transform your text prompts into high-quality digital art instantly. It’s designed to provide a fast and creative collaborative ex

Fixes #13542

gist.headline: A fresh canvas blooms
gist.blurb: AI Art & Image Generator joined the garden: type a thought, get a little digital weather system of pixels back. One more place for prompts to become art without requiring a budget meeting.
gist.summary: Added the AI Art & Image Generator app, a fast collaborative web experience that uses the Pollinations.ai image API to turn text prompts into high-quality digital art.
gist.impact: People can now discover and use another ready-made image-generation app built on the Pollinations.ai API, with prompt-to-art creation available directly in the app directory.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a friendly artist use a cozy retro computer to turn a written prompt into several small framed pixel-art landscapes. A blooming code-plant and scattered paint swatches represent prompt-driven creativity; the screen should show a simple pixel-font label, “AI ART,” while lime green provides the warm studio glow.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art artist's nook where the cute Polli bee mascot, with a tiny painter's beret, hovers beside a retro computer generating small framed digital artworks from a prompt card; Polli has a yellow body with dark brown horizontal stripes, black antennae and oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, a happy smile, and rounded translucent light-blue wings. Lime green (#ecf874) glows from the screen labeled “AI ART,” with pastel paint swatches, code-plants, and flowers around the desk; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
